d:
Soniya gandhi ki kitab 'bilongings: a jarni oph lav' ke bahane is bar bat bhartiy rajniti ki us ghatna ki, jisne desh ki rajniti aur soniya gandhi ki jindgi hamesha ke lie badal di purv pradhanmantri rajiv gandhi ki hatya.
21 maee 1991 ko shriperanbdur men rajiv gandhi ki hatya ki sajish kaise rachi gaee? hamlavar kaun the? janch ejensiyan 90 dinon ke bhitar hatyaron aur unke netvark tak kaise pahunchin? aur kya is sajish ki sabhi parten kabhi samne aa paeen?
